headline: mtg jumps from eighth to third on ARC-3

sections.text: mtg gained 5.99 points to reach 44.32, vaulting from eighth to third in the past day.
That move puts mtg among the board’s top three as the ARC-3 public standings continue to shift.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
